owner_creation.analysis: The prompting exported lbool owns whether a prompt is currently displayed; command.rs:1451 sets it after prompt rendering, and putchr clears it on subsequent output.
owner_creation.invariant: Prompt state owns a Boolean, not prompt text storage.
limitations: prompting owns a display-mode flag but no prompt text.

aliases_escapes.analysis: putchr borrows end_pr_string data after checking the prompting flag; the flag itself provides no lifetime guarantee for that separate prompt buffer.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A prompt-state bit cannot keep prompt bytes alive.
limitations: putchr consumers can observe the flag without retaining the prompt owner.

callback_targets.analysis: screen output can reach putchr through the tputs callback, while command rendering calls it directly; the prompting Boolean stores no callback context.
callback_targets.invariant: Callback output shares the same prompt-state protocol.
limitations: tputs provider correctness is separate from the prompting scalar.

invalidation.analysis: putchr clears the prompting bit before recursively calling putstr on end_pr_string, preventing repeated end-prompt emission on that normal path.
invalidation.invariant: Prompt state is retired before recursive string output.

mutation_commit.analysis: The prompt writer sets the prompting bit only after drawing; putchr clears it before other screen/buffer work, but no owner-wide guard spans these updates.
mutation_commit.invariant: Scalar updates do not atomically commit the whole display.

release_pair.analysis: Clearing prompting releases no heap object; end_pr_string remains borrowed and the command/prompt owner must handle replacement and destruction.
release_pair.invariant: Retiring a prompt bit is distinct from retiring its text.
limitations: Clearing prompting does not retire terminal-provider or prompt allocations.

error_cleanup.analysis: If terminal/output operations fail after the prompting bit changes, the display and state may diverge; the sticky failure owner is separate and cannot validate prompt aliases.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure state cannot be inferred from the prompt Boolean.

signals_handoff.analysis: Asynchronous quit can enter terminal output while prompting and its text/display owners are mid-update; M0-SIG-003 remains open.
signals_handoff.invariant: Prompt state is not an approved handler handoff mechanism.
limitations: This entry does not approve prompt text owners or tputs provider ABI; asynchronous cleanup and display mutation remain separate gates.

src/command.rs.relationship: Prompt rendering sets prompting true after display at src/command.rs:1444-1452; output code consumes that shared display-mode flag without taking prompt-text ownership.

src/screen.rs.relationship: Terminal capability output at src/screen.rs:1685-1694 can route bytes through putchr, where prompting changes output behavior. The provider callback and prompt-text lifetimes remain separate obligations.

src/signal.rs.relationship: terminate at src/signal.rs:83-85 enters quit without touching prompting. These lines alone establish neither a prompt-mode change nor a reentrant tputs callback during display.
